cs.t: Yes, their innovation is in hardware, not software. I also keep my 1986 HP-15C safe and use a DM15L as my everyday calculator (a new meaning for EDC...). In fact I had a NIB HP-15C LE reissue (two, in fact, but one was stolen) and resold it when I got the DM15L (and a second one for redundancy), it's a much better calculator. I have Free42 for my iPhone and iPad but I tend to use the [official HP HP-15C emulator app]( https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hp-15c-calculator/id503720774 ) instead, or PCalc.
cs.th: Build Your Own Classic HP Calculator Emulator
